liner.body_md:
## Setlist highlights

- **Down Yonder**: rare: 7 archived performances [7]
- **Airmail Special**: back after 68 archived shows (402 days) [7]
- **Just Because**: rare: 6 archived performances [7]
- **Blue Mule**: rare: 14 archived performances [7]
- **Four Sticks**: rare: 6 archived performances [7]
- **Christmas Time's A-Coming**: back after 57 archived shows (370 days); rare: 3 archived performances [7]

## The recordings

- **billystrings2023-12-16.akg483.489.marino.flac24** (recommended): audience recording; 26 songs; 153 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [1]
- **billystrings2023-12-16.Schoepsmk41vs.Flac24**: source not stated; 26 songs; 154 min; rated 5/5 by 2 [2]. Said about its sound: Recording is deep, bright and clear; crowd chatter is audible at times but rarely distracting [4]
- **billystrings2023-12-16.Neumann_KK185_flac24**: source not stated; 26 songs; 154 min [3]

## Around the show

- Taper stood at mic stand eleven feet high, front of house right corner, roughly 100 feet from stage [1]
- Taper positioned slightly front of house, to the right [2]
- Reviewer, who had heard other archive shows, found this one stands out; the jam balance and genre variety worked well [4]
- Part of an 11-day run from Greensboro to Syracuse ending 12/16, which the reviewer says delivered nightly [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **billystrings2023-12-16.akg483.489.marino.flac24**: taped by Bob Marino; transferred by Bob Marino; source: AUD>AKG480/CK63/CK69>M2D2>744T [1]. Also: Taped with AKG 480 mics, CK63 hypercardioid pair at 90 degrees plus a CK69 shotgun center, into a 744T recorder; Chain went through a Sonosax M2D2, was mixed in ProTools 2012.7, then encoded to FLAC with Traders Little Helper [1]
- **billystrings2023-12-16.Schoepsmk41vs.Flac24**: taped by Duncan Oldham; transferred by Rich Stoler; source: Schoeps mk41vs > cmc1 w/gakcables > Sound Devices 788T [2]. Also: Transfer from SD card via Audacity (combined, slight amplification, normalized), then CD Wave and Foobar2000 tagging [2]
- **billystrings2023-12-16.Neumann_KK185_flac24**: taped by Duncan Oldham; transferred by Andy Murray; source: Neumann KK185>NBob cables>Baby NBox>788T Chan 3+4 stand 8 feet 24bit/48khz DINa Slightly FOB to the right [3]. Also: FLAC fingerprints were generated with xACT 2.54 on 2023-12-17 [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by BerryLittles: [Billy Strings The Oncenter Dec 16 2023 Poster t-shirt, hoodie, sweater, long sleeve and tank top](https://berrylittles.com/product/billy-strings-the-oncenter-dec-16-2023-poster-t-shirt/) [8]
- Poster by Allison Marie: [Billy Strings Brings Christmas Spirit to Syracuse with Tour Finale](https://nysmusic.com/2023/12/20/billy-strings-brings-christmas-spirit-to-syracuse-with-tour-finale/) [9]
- Fan art by Allison Marie: [Billy Strings Brings Christmas Spirit to Syracuse with Tour Finale](https://nysmusic.com/2023/12/20/billy-strings-brings-christmas-spirit-to-syracuse-with-tour-finale/) [10]
